name: Observation of Higgs boson production in association with a top quark pair

significance.quote: the observed significance is 5.8 standard deviations, compared to an expectation of 4.9 standard deviations

summary.plain: ATLAS observed Higgs bosons being made together with a top quark and its antiparticle, the most direct way to see how strongly the Higgs sticks to the heaviest known particle.
summary.technical: Combination of ttH searches in multilepton, bb and diphoton final states at 7, 8 and 13 TeV (up to 79.8 fb^-1 at 13 TeV): 5.8 sigma observed, 4.9 sigma expected.

title: Observation of Higgs boson production in association with a top quark pair at the LHC with the ATLAS detector
why_it_matters: The top-Higgs Yukawa coupling is the largest in the Standard Model; a direct ttH observation confirmed it at (within uncertainties) the predicted strength rather than through loop-level processes alone.
